scenarios.scenario: Insight — Inspect Distrib property across projects in signing build
scenarios.reasoning: The agent efficiently found the Distrib property values and the signing error, but fell short on the deeper analysis. It correctly identified that only DataSources has Distrib set, but didn't investigate whether other projects might share the same output directory through other mechanisms. The explanation of the signing conflict focuses on a within-project NuGet double-write rather than the cross-project shared directory issue that the rubric expects. The approach was methodical but incomplete in its analysis of shared directories.

rubricScores.criterion: Found the Distrib property value for the DataSources project
Checked whether other projects (Common, StorageLibrary) use the same Distrib path
Identified that multiple projects point to the same shared output folder (e.g. the ConfigurationLinterService path)
Explained how this shared folder causes the signing conflict — signtool encounters files owned by other projects
